🔄 Content Updated (Published: September 21, 2026 / Previously listed: March 30, 2026)

Main changes: Date moved from May 23 to November 15; meeting time changed from 10:00 to 8:00; meeting location changed from Daini Ward Administrative Center to South Koma Ward Administrative Center; distance shortened from approximately 14 km to approximately 9 km; fee changed from ¥200 to free; application deadline moved from May 19 to October 30.

【Event Details】

The 21st South Koma One-Day Walk will be held on Sunday, November 15, 2026. This is a scenic approximately 9-kilometer walk through the autumn foliage route from Misugi-dai to Asahi-yama Observation Park, expected to take about 4 hours.

Meeting time: 8:00 a.m.
Meeting location: South Koma Ward Administrative Center
Fee: Free
Parking: South Koma Junior High School grounds (available)
Day-of participation: Welcome

What to bring: Drinking water, rain gear, Sugo-Ashi handbook (if you have one).

【How to Apply】

Application deadline: Friday, October 30, 2026

Apply to South Koma Ward Administrative Center by:
• Phone: 042-972-2805
• Fax: 042-974-2736
• Email: koma-center@city.hanno.lg.jp

【Weather Policy】

Event cancelled in case of rain. If uncertain about conditions on the day, contact South Koma Ward Administrative Center after 6:30 a.m.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kenkohukusibu/hokencenter/12385.html
